 464     """

 466

 470         cell_type (str): the type of the cell.
 471

 473         source_nb: Fixed code.

 476     for replace_from, replace_to in replaces.items():
 477         break_early = str(nb).count(replace_from) == 1
 478         for i, d in enumerate(new_nb["cells"]):
 479             if d["cell_type"] == cell_type and replace_from in d["source"]:
 480                 d["source"] = d["source"].replace(replace_from, replace_to)
 481                 new_nb["cells"][i] = d
 482                 if break_early:
 483                     break
 484

 486     to_nb = NotebookExporter()
 487     source_nb, _ = to_nb.from_notebook_node(new_nb)
 488
